Name: Mariner B Better
Author: zombifier
Description:
The sequel to the highly popular [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36922]Luremaster B Gone[/url], Mariner B Better buffs the other crab pot profession (Mariner - crab pots no longer produce trash) that also [b]kinda makes your crab pots worse[/b], as trash is a highly valuable source of resource, quartz, and more, and Mariner trades that away for marginally more fish which is not really that valuable.

With this mod installed, with the Mariner profession all crab pots now have a [b]30% chance to produce trash alongside fish[/b], meaning you still get a steady stream of trash for recycling while still keeping your fish! And yes, this works with Luremaster B Gone too, if you have mods that allows you to get both.

[b]Installation instruction:[/b]
[list]
[*]Download and install [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22256]Extra Machine Config[/url]﻿.[/*]
[*]Unzip this mod into the game's Mods folder[/*]
[/list]
[b]Compatibility:[/b] This should be compatible with every mod, with exceptions below:
[list]
[*][b]NOT [/b]compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24355]Walk of Life[/url], because WOL already reworks the professions to be something else, and it would not make sense to have this mod on top. Pairs well with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20054?tab=description]Vanilla Plus Professions[/url] though if you use that![/*]
[*]Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21720]Machine Progression System[/url], however this mod will [b]NOT [/b]modify the behavior of MPS's higher tier crab pots, since they use a totally different system for bait that already doesn't take into account vanilla professions. It is extremely unlikely I will change this.[/*]
[/list]
Source: [url=https://github.com/zombifier/My_Stardew_Mods/tree/master/MarinerBBetter]https://github.com/zombifier/My_Stardew_Mods/tree/master/MarinerBBetter[/url]
